content.short: Usual is a decentralized stablecoin protocol that issues USD0, a RWA-backed asset redistributing value to its users.
content.description: Usual is a pioneering decentralized finance protocol and stablecoin issuer designed to bring transparency and equity to the digital dollar landscape. Its flagship asset, USD0, is a permissionless stablecoin fully backed 1:1 by high-quality real-world assets (RWAs), primarily short-term US Treasury Bills. Unlike centralized competitors, Usual redistributes its protocol earnings and governance influence directly to its community through the $USUAL token. The platform focuses on professional-grade compliance and security, serving as a vital bridge between traditional stability and DeFi.
content.meta: Usual provides the RWA-backed USD0 stablecoin and a decentralized governance model. Discover Usual and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
